# Copilot instructions: Marginalia Fighters

The instructions for every coding agent live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), with per-area rules in [docs/agents/areas.md](../docs/agents/areas.md). Follow them; this file only points there.

In short: Angular 22, zoneless, signals. `src/app/domain/` and `src/app/data/` stay framework-free and hold every game rule. Components are presentational and keep their `data-testid` hooks. Track work in [docs/BACKLOG.md](../docs/BACKLOG.md).
